title: Law to require guidance on service animal access
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, working with the Commission on Human Rights and the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities, to create guidance and a public education campaign on service animal rights in restaurants, stores, hotels and other public places. It would require pamphlets, model signage and online materials explaining what counts as a service animal, what businesses can and cannot ask, and how to file a complaint. The materials would need to be published within one year and reviewed at least every three years.
